title: A Little Free Library for Our Street
points: Greet the neighbours and say what you want to build.
Show a photo of a small wooden box on a post.
Explain that anyone can take a book or leave one.
Say where it would stand, at the corner by the bus stop.
Describe the volunteers who will build it on a Saturday.
Give the cost, about the price of one tank of paint.
Ask for a show of hands.

title: Starting a Walking Club
points: Open with the empty path behind the school.
Name the problem: nobody walks together.
Give the plan: a short walk every Tuesday.
Pick a meeting spot at the front gate.
Show the route on a hand-drawn map.
Offer a badge for every ten walks.

title: Planning a Class Trip to a Museum
points: Start by holding up a ticket.
Explain that the museum has a room of fossils.
Describe the bus and the driver.
Say what to pack: lunch and a notebook.
Give the date and the clock time the bus leaves.

title: Welcoming New Chess Club Members
points: Smile and hold up a chess king.
Say the club meets on Wednesdays.
Explain that beginners play first on the small boards.
Show the clock used in timed games.
Point to the shelf of loan books.

title: Organising a Bake Sale
points: Hold up a tray of cookies.
State the goal: new books for the library.
Pick a date on the calendar, the first Saturday of the month.
Set up tables by the front door.
Ask each family to bring one batch.
Count the coins in a jar at the end.
Thank everyone with a round of applause.

title: A Recycling Plan for the Office
points: Say that most of it is paper.
Propose a blue bin at each desk.
Name a person who empties the bins on Fridays.
Add a poster by the printer.
Mark a short check on the calendar after one month.
Weigh the paper saved on a scale and report it.
Finish with a question for the team.

title: Pitching a Rooftop Garden
points: Begin with a picture of the flat roof.
Explain the sunshine it gets all day.
List the plants: tomatoes, beans and herbs.
Show the wooden boxes along the edge.
Describe the water barrel that catches rain.
Set a rota for who waters.
Explain the cost in a simple chart.
Close by handing out packets of seeds.

title: Introducing Our Volunteer Day
points: Say the day is the second Sunday of spring.
Mention the lunch under the oak tree.
End with a group photo taken on a camera.

title: Explaining a New Bus Route
points: Show a map with a red line.
Say the route begins at the market.
Name the three stops after it.
Point out the new stop at the library.
Give the first bus time in the morning.
Say a ticket costs the same as before.
Add that buses have a ramp.
End with a phone number to call.

title: A Quiet Study Hour at School
points: Pick up a pencil and hold it still.
Explain the hour runs after lunch.
List the rules: no talking, no phones.
Put out a basket for phones.
Provide a timer on the desk.

title: Launching a Seed Swap
points: Hold up a paper envelope of seeds.
Say people bring seeds they do not need.
Set out a long table with labels.
Explain how to take one packet for each you give.
Plan the first swap in March.
Hand out blank labels and a pen.

title: Open House for Our Makerspace
points: Greet visitors at the red door.
Show the wood bench and its tools.
Close with a chance to try a project.

title: Annual Report of the Park Crew
points: Begin with the number of trees planted.
Mention the new path to the lake.
Say how many bags of litter were collected.
Share the ducks counted in spring.
Show next year on a map.

title: Planning a Community Film Night
points: Choose the hall with a big white wall.
List the speaker and cables to borrow.
Set up folding chairs in rows.
Plan a popcorn stand by the door.
Set the start time at dusk.
Thank the sponsor and wave goodnight.

title: Training New Lighthouse Guides
points: Teach the greeting at the gate.
Describe the 90 stairs to the top.
Share a story about the old keeper.
Show where the safety rail is.

title: New Signs for the Nature Trail
points: Hold up a small wooden sign.
Say the old signs have faded in the sun.
Show the map of the loop around the lake.
Explain the colour code painted on the posts.
Mention the bird pictures on each sign.
Ask for helpers to carry the posts on Saturday.
